name: Elsa
source:
One of Doctor West's creations, Elsa is a gynoid, built to be stronger and faster than an ordinary human, equipped with a pair of tonfas. 
She ends most of her sentences with the suffix "robo".
[spoiler]Although she recognizes Kurou as her enemy, following an encounter where he saves her, Elsa admits her love to Kurou, much to his confusion.[/spoiler] 

Elsa's name is probably derived from Elsa Sullivan Lanchester, the star of the movie Bride of Frankenstein.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Demonbane_characters#Elsa]Wikipedia[/url].]

[spoiler]She became an Elder God along with [url=https://vndb.org/c1008]Doctor West[/url] in the Secret Ending of [url=https://vndb.org/v234/]Kishin Hishou[/url], after defeated [url=https://vndb.org/c12696]Another Blood[/url] and went through 996 different scenarios, much to [url=https://vndb.org/c935]Nya[/url]'s surprisement and a dumbfounded [url=https://vndb.org/c12697]Nero[/url].[/spoiler]
